subject: Further Mathematics

questions.q: For a smooth curve $y = f(x)$, a turning point is classified as a local maximum if:
questions.explain: By the second derivative test, a stationary point (where the first derivative $\frac{dy}{dx} = 0$) is a local maximum if the second derivative evaluated at that point is strictly less than 0 (the curve is concave downward).
